newsitem.title: CHINA: Deposits in China rural financial institutions.
newsitem.headline: Deposits in China rural financial institutions.

text.p: Deposits in China's rural financial institutions reached 1.6986 trillion yuan ($204.6 billion) by the end of August in 1996, the China Securities said on Wednesday.

Rural financial institutions extended 1.8528 trillion yuan ($223.2 billion) in agricultural loans in the first eight months of 1996, the newspaper quoted Duan Xiaoyang of the rural financial reform deparment of the State Council as saying.
China's rural financial institutions include branches of the China Agriculture Development Bank (CADB) and local rural credit agencies.
CADB would increase set up more than 2,300 new branches this year to support agricultural development, the People's Daily quoted Duan as saying in a separate report.
CADB, one of China's three state policy banks, was set up in 1994 to supply and manage funds for purchasing grains, cotton, vegetable oil and other products.
